korean-k1-l1.title: Vogál bázika sira
korean-k1-l1.concept: Hangul mak alfabetu koreanu. Sílaba ida-idak mak bloku ida. Vogál mesak ida hakerek ho **ㅇ** iha oin, no iha hahú ida-ne'e la iha lian: 아 mak “a” de'it.
korean-k1-l1.example: 아 · 어 · 오 · 우 · 으 · 이 (a · eo · o · u · eu · i)

korean-k1-l2.title: Konsoante bázika sira
korean-k1-l2.concept: Tau konsoante ida iha vogál nia oin atu halo bloku sílaba ida: **ㄱ + ㅏ = 가** (ga). Lee bloku husi karuk ba loos.
korean-k1-l2.example: 가 · 나 · 다 · 마 · 바 · 사 · 하 (ga · na · da · ma · ba · sa · ha)

korean-k1-l3.title: Liafuan dahuluk sira
korean-k1-l3.concept: Kesi bloku sílaba sira atu halo liafuan. Lee bloku ida-idak, depois dehan hamutuk.

korean-k1-l4.title: Vogál Y
korean-k1-l4.concept: Tau liña badak ida halo lian **y**: ㅏ → ㅑ (ya), ㅓ → ㅕ (yeo), ㅗ → ㅛ (yo), ㅜ → ㅠ (yu). ㅐ (ae) no ㅔ (e) iha Koreanu modernu lian hanesan tebes.
korean-k1-l4.example: 야 · 여 · 요 · 유 (ya · yeo · yo · yu)

korean-k1-l5.title: Konsoante tan
korean-k1-l5.concept: ㄹ mak lian entre “r” no “l”. ㅈ (j), ㅊ (ch, ho anin sai), ㅋ (k, ho anin sai), ㅌ (t, ho anin sai) no ㅍ (p, ho anin sai) kompleta konsoante bázika sira.
korean-k1-l5.example: 라 · 자 · 차 · 카 · 타 · 파 (ra · ja · cha · ka · ta · pa)

korean-k1-l6.title: Konsoante dobradu
korean-k1-l6.concept: ㄲ, ㄸ, ㅃ, ㅆ no ㅉ mak lian tensu: hatete ho kakorok kesi no la iha anin sai, hanesan lian dahuluk iha “skate”.
korean-k1-l6.example: 까 · 따 · 빠 · 싸 · 짜 (kka · tta · ppa · ssa · jja)

korean-k1-l7.title: Konsoante final
korean-k1-l7.concept: Konsoante ne'ebé hela iha sílaba okos bolu **받침 (batchim)**. Nia taka sílaba: 안 (an), 말 (mal), 밤 (bam), 강 (gang), 집 (jip), 책 (chaek). Iha ikus bele iha lian hitu de'it: ㄱ ㄴ ㄷ ㄹ ㅁ ㅂ ㅇ.
korean-k1-l7.example: 안 · 말 · 밤 · 강 · 집 (an · mal · bam · gang · jip)

korean-k1-l8.title: Liafuan loroloron
korean-k1-l8.concept: Lee liafuan ida-idak sílaba ida-idak. 학교 lee “hakgyo”: ㄱ final husi 학 taka no sílaba tuir mai hatete ho kesi.

korean-k1-l9.title: Liafuan kona-ba mundu
korean-k1-l9.concept: Ema no natureza: 사람 (ema), 나라 (nasaun), 하늘 (lalehan), 산 (foho), 강 (ribeira), 꽃 (funan).

korean-k2-l1.title: Olá no obrigadu
korean-k2-l1.concept: Kumprimentu ho respeitu remata ho **-요** ka **-니다**. 안녕하세요 bele uza iha oras hotu.

korean-k2-l2.title: Sin, lae no diak
korean-k2-l2.concept: Resposta badak no ho respeitu ne'ebé ita bele uza loroloron. Koreanu aumenta **요** iha rohan atu hatudu respeitu.

korean-k2-l3.title: Kontente hasoru ita
korean-k2-l3.concept: Bainhira ita hasoru ema foun, dehan 만나서 반갑습니다. Iha dalan rua atu dehan adeus: ida ba ema ne'ebé sai, ida ba ema ne'ebé hela.
korean-k2-l3.example: 만나서 반갑습니다. (mannaseo bangapseumnida.) = Kontente hasoru ita.

korean-k2-l4.title: Espresaun ho respeitu
korean-k2-l4.concept: Uza 실례합니다 atu foti ema nia atensaun ka liu, 고마워요 atu hato'o obrigadu ho belun, 천만에요 atu hatán obrigadu, no 축하해요 atu fó parabéns.

korean-k2-l5.title: Naran no nasaun
korean-k2-l5.concept: Husu naran ho 이름이 뭐예요? no nasaun ho 어느 나라 사람이에요? Hatán ho 제 이름은 ___예요 ka 저는 ___ 사람이에요.
korean-k2-l5.example: 이름이 뭐예요? (ireumi mwoyeyo?) = Ita-nia naran saida?

korean-k2-l6.title: Hateten adeus
korean-k2-l6.concept: Entre belun bele dehan 잘 가요 (adeus), 내일 봐요 (to'o aban), 또 만나요 (to'o fali) no 잘 자요 (toba di'ak).
korean-k2-l6.example: 잘 가요. (jal gayo.) = Adeus. (ho belun) / 내일 봐요. (naeil bwayo.) = To'o aban.

korean-k2-l7.title: Ita di'ak ka lae?
korean-k2-l7.concept: Husu 잘 지냈어요? (Ita di'ak ka lae?) no hatán 잘 지내요 (Ha'u di'ak). 좋은 아침이에요 signifika “Dader di'ak ida.”

korean-k2-l8.title: Husu ajuda
korean-k2-l8.concept: Dehan 도와주세요 atu husu ajuda, 모르겠어요 bainhira la hatene, 알겠어요 bainhira komprende, no 다시 말해 주세요 atu husu ema hatete fali.
korean-k2-l8.example: 도와주세요. (dowajuseyo.) = Favór ajuda ha'u. / 알겠어요. (algesseoyo.) = Ha'u komprende.

korean-k2-l9.title: Gosta no resposta
korean-k2-l9.concept: 좋아요 signifika di'ak ka diak, 싫어요 signifika la gosta, 맞아요 signifika “loos” no 틀려요 signifika “sala”.
korean-k2-l9.example: 좋아요. (joayo.) = Di'ak. / 싫어요. (sireoyo.) = Ha'u la gosta.

korean-k2-l10.title: Sinál sira ne’ebé ita sei haree
korean-k2-l10.concept: Iha Korea iha sinál badak barak iha fatin hotu-hotu. **입구** katak odamatan tama, **출구** odamatan sai no **화장실** katak toilete. Iha odamatan, **미세요** katak “kudu” no **당기세요** katak “sona”.
korean-k2-l10.example: 입구 (ipgu) = Odamatan tama / 출구 (chulgu) = Odamatan sai

korean-k2-l11.title: Obrigadu ba han
korean-k2-l11.concept: Molok han ita hateten **잘 먹겠습니다** no kuandu hotu han ita hateten **잘 먹었습니다**. Na’i-uma simu bainaka ho **어서 오세요**, no **맛있어요** katak han ne’e di’ak.
korean-k2-l11.example: 잘 먹겠습니다. (jal meokgetseumnida.) = Hateten molok han: “Hau sei han di’ak.” / 잘 먹었습니다. (jal meogeotseumnida.) = Hateten hafoin han: “Hau han di’ak ona.”

korean-k3-l1.title: Ha'u estudante
korean-k3-l1.concept: **저는** katak “ha'u” (ho respeitu). Tau **이에요** depois konsoante no **예요** depois vogál atu dehan “Ha'u …”.

korean-k3-l2.title: Ha'u-nia família
korean-k3-l2.concept: Iha koreanu, ema uza liafuan família barak, to'o mós ba ema ne'ebé la'ós família.

korean-k3-l3.title: Sura
korean-k3-l3.concept: Koreanu iha sistema númeru rua: koreanu nativu (하나, 둘, 셋 …) atu sura sasán, no sino-koreanu (일, 이, 삼 …) ba osan, data no minutu.

korean-k3-l4.title: Númeru koreanu nian 6–10
korean-k3-l4.concept: Kontinua númeru koreanu nian: 여섯 (6), 일곱 (7), 여덟 (8), 아홉 (9), 열 (10).
korean-k3-l4.example: 여섯 · 일곱 · 여덟 · 아홉 · 열 (yeoseot · ilgop · yeodeol · ahop · yeol)

korean-k3-l5.title: Númeru sino-koreanu
korean-k3-l5.concept: Númeru sino-koreanu: 일 (1), 이 (2), 삼 (3), 사 (4), 오 (5), 육 (6), 칠 (7), 팔 (8), 구 (9), 십 (10). Uza ba osan, data, númeru telefone no minutu.
korean-k3-l5.example: 일 · 이 · 삼 · 사 · 오 · 육 · 칠 · 팔 · 구 · 십 (il · i · sam · sa · o · yuk · chil · pal · gu · sip)

korean-k3-l6.title: Idade
korean-k3-l6.concept: Husu 몇 살이에요? (Ita nia idade hira?). Idade uza númeru koreanu nian ho 살: 열 살 (tinan 10), 스무 살 (20), 서른 살 (30).
korean-k3-l6.example: 몇 살이에요? (myeot sarieyo?) = Ita nia idade hira?

korean-k3-l8.title: Liafuan família tan
korean-k3-l8.concept: Liafuan ba alin-maun sira muda tuir ema ne'ebé koalia: feto ida dehan 오빠 (maun) no 언니 (biin). Mós 아들 (oan-mane), 딸 (oan-feto), 부모님 (inan-aman).
korean-k3-l8.example: 오빠 (oppa) = maun (feto nia dehan) / 언니 (eonni) = biin (feto nia dehan)

korean-k3-l9.title: Ami-nia família
korean-k3-l9.concept: Koreanu sira dala barak dehan 우리 (ami, ita-nia) troka “ha'u-nia”: 우리 가족 signifika “ha'u-nia família”. Sura ema ho 명: 네 명 (ema na'in haat).

korean-k3-l10.title: Haruka mensajen ba kolega
korean-k3-l10.concept: Mensajen uza fraze badak no respeitu ne’ebé remata ho **-요**. **지금 어디예요?** husu “ita iha ne’ebé agora?”, **곧 가요** katak “hau mai lalais” no **늦어요** katak “hau tarde”.
korean-k3-l10.example: 지금 어디예요? (jigeum eodiyeyo?) = Ita iha ne’ebé agora? / 곧 가요. (got gayo.) = Hau mai lalais.

korean-k3-l11.title: Lee liafuan sira ho lian ki’ik
korean-k3-l11.concept: Bainhira síla-ba ida remata ho konsoante no tuir mai komesa ho vogál, lian ne’e muda ba oin: 책이 lee **chaegi** no 밥을 lee **babeul**. Lian balu mós muda lian viziñu: 국물 lee **gungmul** no 같이 lee **gachi**.

korean-k4-l1.title: Verbu loroloron sira
korean-k4-l1.concept: Verbu prezente ho respeitu remata ho **-아요 / -어요 / -해요**. Forma hanesan uza ba “ha'u”, “ita” no “sira”.

korean-k4-l2.title: Bá fatin sira
korean-k4-l2.concept: Tau **에** depois fatin ida atu dehan ita bá ka mai ne'ebé: 학교에 가요. Verbu mai ikus.
korean-k4-l2.example: 학교에 가요. (hakgyoe gayo.) = Ha'u bá eskola.

korean-k4-l3.title: Han, hemu, lee
korean-k4-l3.concept: Verbu nia objetu hetan **을** depois konsoante no **를** depois vogál: 밥을 먹어요, 커피를 마셔요.
korean-k4-l3.example: 밥을 먹어요. (babeul meogeoyo.) = Ha'u han etu.

korean-k4-l4.title: Hahán no hemu
korean-k4-l4.concept: 밥 (etu, hahán), 빵 (paun), 과일 (fuan-ai), 고기 (naan), 물 (bee), 우유 (susubeen).

korean-k4-l5.title: Gosta no la gosta
korean-k4-l5.concept: Dehan buat ne'ebé ita gosta ho -를/을 좋아해요 no buat ne'ebé ita la gosta ho -를/을 싫어해요: 저는 사과를 좋아해요.

korean-k4-l6.title: Deskreve buat sira
korean-k4-l6.concept: Liafuan deskrisaun mós remata ho -요: 커요 (boot), 작아요 (ki'ik), 많아요 (barak), 맛있어요 (gostu), 예뻐요 (bonita).

korean-k4-l7.title: Klima
korean-k4-l7.concept: 날씨 (klima), 더워요 (manas), 추워요 (malirin), 비가 와요 (udan monu), 눈이 와요 (neve monu).

korean-k4-l8.title: Hateten lae ho 안 no 못
korean-k4-l8.concept: Tau **안** molok verbu atu dehan ita la halo buat ida (안 가요). Tau **못** molok nia atu dehan ita labele (못 가요).
korean-k4-l8.example: 안 먹어요. (an meogeoyo.) = Ha'u la han.

korean-k4-l9.title: Atividade loroloron
korean-k4-l9.concept: 일어나요 (hamriik), 씻어요 (hariis), 일해요 (serbisu), 자요 (toba). Liafuan tempu hanesan 아침 (dader) no 밤 (kalan) simu 에: 아침에.

korean-k5-l1.title: Horiseik, ohin, aban
korean-k5-l1.concept: Liafuan kona-ba tempu baibain mai besik fraze nia hahú.

korean-k5-l2.title: Saida mak ha'u halo ona
korean-k5-l2.concept: Tempu pasadu: **-았어요 / -었어요 / -했어요**. Verbu balu sai badak liu: 가다 → 갔어요, 보다 → 봤어요.

korean-k5-l3.title: Saida mak ha'u sei halo
korean-k5-l3.concept: Uza **-(으)ㄹ 거예요** ba planu: 가다 → 갈 거예요, 먹다 → 먹을 거예요.
korean-k5-l3.example: 내일 갈 거예요. (naeil gal geoyeyo.) = Aban ha'u sei bá.

korean-k5-l4.title: Loron semana nian
korean-k5-l4.concept: 월요일 (Segunda), 화요일 (Tersa), 수요일 (Kuarta), 목요일 (Kinta), 금요일 (Sesta), 토요일 (Sabadu), 일요일 (Domingu).

korean-k5-l5.title: Fulan sira
korean-k5-l5.concept: Fulan mak númeru sino-koreanu mais 월: 일월 (Janeiru), 삼월 (Marsu), 오월 (Maiu), 칠월 (Jullu), 구월 (Setembru), 십이월 (Dezembru).

korean-k5-l6.title: Dehan oras
korean-k5-l6.concept: Oras uza númeru koreanu nian mais 시: 한 시 (1:00), 두 시 (2:00), 세 시 (3:00), 열 시 (10:00). Husu 몇 시예요?
korean-k5-l6.example: 한 시 · 두 시 · 세 시 (han si · du si · se si)

korean-k5-l7.title: Dala hira
korean-k5-l7.concept: 매일 (loron-loron), 자주 (dala barak), 가끔 (dala ruma), 항상 (nafatin). Tau sira molok verbu.

korean-k5-l8.title: Tempu pasadu tan
korean-k5-l8.concept: Final tempu pasadu mak -았/었어요: 했어요 (halo ona), 왔어요 (mai ona), 만났어요 (hasoru ona), 샀어요 (sosa ona), 잤어요 (toba ona).

korean-k5-l9.title: Aniversáriu no fim-de-semana
korean-k5-l9.concept: 생일 (aniversáriu), 주말 (fim-de-semana), 선물 (prezente). Husu 생일이 언제예요? no hatán 제 생일은 오월이에요.
korean-k5-l9.example: 생일이 언제예요? (saengiri eonjeyeyo?) = Ita-nia aniversáriu bainhira?

korean-k6-l1.title: Iha loja
korean-k6-l1.concept: Husu folin ho 얼마예요? no husu buat ruma ho **… 주세요** (… favór).

korean-k6-l2.title: Iha ne'ebé?
korean-k6-l2.concept: Husu **… 어디예요?** (… iha ne'ebé?). Rona didi'ak 오른쪽 (loos), 왼쪽 (karuk) no 직진 (tuir los).
korean-k6-l2.example: 화장실이 어디예요? (hwajangsiri eodiyeyo?) = Sentina iha ne'ebé?

korean-k6-l3.title: Ha'u hakarak …
korean-k6-l3.concept: Aumenta **-고 싶어요** ba verbu nia abut atu dehan saida mak ita hakarak halo: 가다 → 가고 싶어요.
korean-k6-l3.example: 가고 싶어요. (gago sipeoyo.) = Ha'u hakarak bá.

korean-k6-l4.title: Iha restaurante
korean-k6-l4.concept: 메뉴 (menu), 주문할게요 (ha'u sei husu), 물 더 주세요 (favór fó bee tan), 계산해 주세요 (favór konta).

korean-k6-l5.title: Viaja
korean-k6-l5.concept: 버스 (otobus), 지하철 (metro), 택시 (taxi), 기차 (komboiu). Dehan oinsá ita bá ho -로/으로: 버스로 가요.

korean-k6-l6.title: Telefone no mensajen
korean-k6-l6.concept: 전화 (telefone), 전화번호 (númeru telefone), 문자 (mensajen). 전화해요 signifika “ha'u telefone”.

korean-k6-l7.title: Iha hospitál
korean-k6-l7.concept: 병원 (hospitál), 약 (aimoruk), 아파요 (moras). Dehan parte isin uluk: 머리가 아파요 (ulun moras).

korean-k6-l8.title: Husu ho respeitu
korean-k6-l8.concept: -세요 no -아/어 주세요 halo pedidu ho respeitu: 앉으세요 (favór tuur), 기다려 주세요 (favór hein), 문을 열어 주세요 (favór loke odamatan).

korean-k6-l9.title: Halo planu hamutuk
korean-k6-l9.concept: 같이 (hamutuk) konvida ema: 같이 가요. 갈래요? husu “Ita hakarak bá ka lae?” no 시간 있어요? husu “Ita iha tempu ka lae?”
korean-k6-l9.example: 같이 가요. (gachi gayo.) = Ita bá hamutuk.

korean-k7-l1.title: Final formál ho respeitu
korean-k7-l1.concept: Iha ko'alia formál no iha servisu, tau -ㅂ니다 ba radikal verbu ka adjetivu ne'ebé remata ho vogál no -습니다 ba radikal ne'ebé remata ho konsoante. Perguntas remata ho -ㅂ니까 / -습니까.
korean-k7-l1.example: 저는 학생입니다. (jeoneun haksaengimnida.) = Hau estudante. / 이름이 무엇입니까? (ireumi mueosimnikka?) = Ita-nia naran saida?

korean-k7-l2.title: Forma simples
korean-k7-l2.concept: Estilu simples (hakerek) remata sentensa deklarativa ho -ㄴ다 / -는다 no sentensa pasadu ho -았다 / -었다. Forma sira ne'e mak baze ba diskursu indireta iha lisaun tuir mai.
korean-k7-l2.example: 나는 학교에 간다. (naneun hakgyoe ganda.) = Hau ba eskola. / 동생은 책을 읽는다. (dongsaengeun chaegeul ingneunda.) = Hau-nia alin lee livru.

korean-k7-l3.title: Deskreve naran
korean-k7-l3.concept: Verbu ka adjetivu bele deskreve naran: -(으)ㄴ ba adjetivu no asaun pasadu, -는 ba asaun agora, -(으)ㄹ ba asaun futuru ka planeadu; tau molok naran.
korean-k7-l3.example: 저는 맛있는 음식을 좋아해요. (jeoneun masinneun eumsigeul joahaeyo.) = Hau gosta hahán gostu. / 예쁜 꽃을 샀어요. (yeppeun kkocheul sasseoyo.) = Hau sosa ai-funan furak.

korean-k7-l4.title: Konektór báziku
korean-k7-l4.concept: Hatama klausula rua ho -아/어서 (razaun ka sekuénsia), -지만 (kontrastu), -(으)니까 (razaun), -(으)면 (se) no -(으)려고 (atu).
korean-k7-l4.example: 피곤해서 일찍 잤어요. (pigonhaeseo iljjik jasseoyo.) = Hau kolen, entaun hau toba sedu. / 비가 와서 집에 있었어요. (biga waseo jibe isseosseoyo.) = Udan monu, entaun hau hela iha uma.

korean-k7-l5.title: Kapasidade, obrigasaun, lisensa
korean-k7-l5.concept: -(으)ㄹ 수 있다/없다 hatudu kapasidade ka posibilidade, -아/어야 하다 obrigasaun, no -아/어도 되다 lisensa.
korean-k7-l5.example: 저는 수영할 수 있어요. (jeoneun suyeonghal su isseoyo.) = Hau bele nani. / 저는 한국어로 이야기할 수 있어요. (jeoneun hangugeoro iyagihal su isseoyo.) = Hau bele ko'alia ho lian Korea.

korean-k7-l6.title: Indirect statements (-다고 하다)
korean-k7-l6.concept: Report what someone says or said: verb/adj + -다고 하다.
korean-k7-l6.example: 친구가 온다고 해요. (chinguga ondago haeyo.) = friend said coming

korean-k7-l7.title: Indirect questions (-냐고 하다)
korean-k7-l7.example: 어디 가냐고 물었어요. (eodi ganyago mureosseoyo.) = asked where going

korean-k7-l8.title: Indirect commands and suggestions (-라고 / -자고 하다)
korean-k7-l8.concept: Report an imperative (-라고 하다) or propositive (-자고 하다).
korean-k7-l8.example: 빨리 오라고 했어요. (ppalli orago haesseoyo.) = told to come fast / 같이 가자고 했어요. (gachi gajago haesseoyo.) = suggested go together

korean-k7-l9.title: Complex causes and contrasts (-느라고, -는데도)
korean-k7-l9.concept: Negative cause or delay (-느라고) and contrast despite circumstances (-는데도).
korean-k7-l9.example: 공부하느라고 바빴어요. (gongbuhaneurago bapasseoyo.) = busy studying / 비가 오는데도 갔어요. (biga oneundedo gasseoyo.) = went despite rain

korean-k7-l10.title: Proportion and inevitability (-을수록, -기 마련이다)
korean-k7-l10.concept: The more... the more (-을수록) and natural inevitability (-기 마련이다).
korean-k7-l10.example: 만날수록 좋아요. (mannalsurok joayo.) = better as we meet / 사람은 실수하기 마련이에요. (sarameun silsuhagi maryeonieyo.) = bound to make mistakes

korean-k7-l11.title: Appearance and inference (-아/어 보이다, -는 모양이다)
korean-k7-l11.concept: Looks like (-아/어 보이다) and appears to be (-는 모양이다).
korean-k7-l11.example: 행복해 보여요. (haengbokae boyeoyo.) = looks happy / 비가 오는 모양이에요. (biga oneun moyangieyo.) = seems raining

korean-k7-l12.title: Pretending (-는 척하다)
korean-k7-l12.concept: Pretend to do or be something: -(으)ㄴ/는 척하다.
korean-k7-l12.example: 아는 척해요. (aneun cheokaeyo.) = pretends to know

korean-k7-l13.title: Regret and counterfactuals (-(으)ㄹ 걸 그랬어요)
korean-k7-l13.concept: Express regret: 'I should have done...' -(으)ㄹ 걸 그랬어요.
korean-k7-l13.example: 일찍 올 걸 그랬어요. (iljjik ol geol geuraesseoyo.) = should have come early

korean-k7-l14.title: K7 Comprehensive Review
korean-k7-l14.concept: Review indirect speech, complex connectors and nuanced expressions.
korean-k7-l14.example: 친구가 온다고 했어요. (chinguga ondago haesseoyo.) = friend said coming / 같이 밥 먹자고 했어요. (gachi bap meokjago haesseoyo.) = suggested eat together

korean-k8-l1.title: Honorific vocabulary for subjects
korean-k8-l1.concept: Special honorific nouns and verbs for revered people: 진지, 주무시다, 편찮으시다.
korean-k8-l1.example: 할머니께서 진지를 드세요. (halmeonikkeseo jinjireul deuseyo.) = grandmother eats meal

korean-k8-l2.title: Object honorific verbs (드리다, 뵙다, 여쭙다)
korean-k8-l2.concept: Humble/honorific verbs when the action is directed toward an elder: 드리다, 뵙다, 여쭙다.
korean-k8-l2.example: 선물을 드려요. (seonmureul deuryeoyo.) = give gift honorific / 내일 봬요. (naeil bwaeyo.) = see tomorrow honorific

korean-k8-l3.title: Affix passives (-이/히/리/기-)
korean-k8-l3.concept: Passive verbs formed by adding -이/히/리/기-: 보이다, 들리다, 열리다, 닫히다.
korean-k8-l3.example: 문이 열려요. (muni yeollyeoyo.) = door opens / 창문이 닫혀요. (changmuni dachyeoyo.) = window closes

korean-k8-l4.title: Syntactic passives (-어지다, -게 되다)
korean-k8-l4.concept: Verbs taking spontaneous or resulting passive forms: -아/어지다, -게 되다.
korean-k8-l4.example: 글씨가 써져요. (geulssiga sseojyeoyo.) = letter written well / 알게 되었어요. (alge doeeosseoyo.) = came to know

korean-k8-l5.title: Affix causatives (-이/히/리/기/우-)
korean-k8-l5.concept: Causative verbs that make someone do an action: 보여 주다, 먹이다, 입히다.
korean-k8-l5.example: 사진을 보여 줘요. (sajineul boyeo jwoyo.) = shows photo / 아기에게 밥을 먹여요. (agiege babeul meogyeoyo.) = feeds baby

korean-k8-l6.title: Syntactic causatives (-게 하다)
korean-k8-l6.concept: Make or cause someone to do something: -게 하다.
korean-k8-l6.example: 웃게 해요. (utge haeyo.) = makes laugh / 기다리게 했어요. (gidarige haesseoyo.) = made wait

korean-k8-l7.title: Public formal style (-하십시오)
korean-k8-l7.concept: High formal deferential style for announcements and ceremonies: -하십시오, -하십시다.
korean-k8-l7.example: 자리에 앉으십시오. (jarie anjeusipsio.) = please be seated / 출발하십시다. (chulbalhasipsida.) = let us depart

korean-k8-l8.title: Modest and humble expressions
korean-k8-l8.concept: Polite speech using humble pronouns and verbs: 저희, 말씀 올리다.
korean-k8-l8.example: 인사 말씀 올립니다. (insa malsseum ollimnida.) = offer greeting words / 저희 학교입니다. (jeohui hakgyoimnida.) = our school humble

korean-k8-l9.title: K8 Comprehensive Review
korean-k8-l9.concept: Review honorifics, passive, causative and formal polite registers.
korean-k8-l9.example: 할머니께 선물을 드렸어요. (halmeonikke seonmureul deuryeosseoyo.) = gave gift to grandmother / 문이 저절로 닫혔어요. (muni jeojeollo dachyeosseoyo.) = door closed by itself

korean-k9-l1.title: Business email writing and requests
korean-k9-l1.concept: Formal business email conventions: -에 관하여, 검토 부탁드립니다.
korean-k9-l1.example: 회의 안건에 관하여 말씀드립니다. (hoeui angeone gwanhayeo malsseumdeurimnida.) = regarding meeting agenda

korean-k9-l2.title: Business telephone etiquette
korean-k9-l2.concept: Handling calls and messages: 통화 가능하신지요, 연결해 드리겠습니다.
korean-k9-l2.example: 지금 통화 가능하신지요? (jigeum tonghwa ganeunghasinjiyo?) = available to speak now / 담당자를 연결해 드리겠습니다. (damdangjareul yeongyeolhae deurigetseumnida.) = connecting person in charge

korean-k9-l3.title: Scheduling and rescheduling
korean-k9-l3.concept: Proposing and changing appointment times: 변경하고자 합니다, 양해 부탁드립니다.
korean-k9-l3.example: 일정을 변경하고자 합니다. (iljeongeul byeongyeonghagoja hamnida.) = schedule change request / 너른 양해 부탁드립니다. (neoreun yanghae butakdeurimnida.) = ask kind understanding

korean-k9-l4.title: Meeting discussions and opinions
korean-k9-l4.concept: Expressing views during meetings: 제 생각으로는, 찬성합니다, 추가 검토.
korean-k9-l4.example: 제 생각으로는 이번 안이 좋습니다. (je saenggakeoroneun ibeon ani jotseumnida.) = in my opinion proposal good / 적극 찬성합니다. (jeokgeuk chanseonghamnida.) = strongly agree

korean-k9-l5.title: Reporting project progress
korean-k9-l5.concept: Giving status updates: 진행 상황을 보고합니다, 조치를 완료했습니다.
korean-k9-l5.example: 프로젝트 진행 상황을 보고합니다. (peurojekteu jinhaeng sanghwangeul bogohamnida.) = reporting project progress / 조치를 완료했습니다. (jochireul wallyohaesseumnida.) = completed action

korean-k9-l6.title: Statistical figures and data trends
korean-k9-l6.concept: Describing trends and numbers: 증가했습니다, 전년 대비.
korean-k9-l6.example: 매출이 증가했습니다. (maechuri jeunggahaesseumnida.) = sales increased / 전년 대비 상승했습니다. (jeonnyeon daebi sangseunghaesseumnida.) = increased compared to last year

korean-k9-l7.title: Business negotiations and partnerships
korean-k9-l7.concept: Professional collaboration: 상호 협력을 희망합니다, 절충안 제시.
korean-k9-l7.example: 상호 협력을 희망합니다. (sangho hyeomnyeogeul huimanghamnida.) = hope mutual cooperation / 절충안을 제안합니다. (jeolchuganeul jeanhamnida.) = propose compromise

korean-k9-l8.title: Business cards and professional titles
korean-k9-l8.concept: Exchanging cards and titles: 처음 뵙겠습니다, 명함 드립니다.
korean-k9-l8.example: 처음 뵙겠습니다, 명함 드립니다. (cheoeum boepgetseumnida, myeongham deurimnida.) = pleased to meet card / 김 부장님입니다. (gim bujangnimimnida.) = department manager kim

korean-k9-l9.title: K9 Comprehensive Review
korean-k9-l9.concept: Review professional communications, formal correspondence and meetings.
korean-k9-l9.example: 안건을 검토해 주시기 바랍니다. (angeoneul geomtohae jusigi baramnida.) = please review agenda / 회의에서 뵙겠습니다. (hoeuieseo boepgetseumnida.) = see you at meeting

korean-k10-l1.title: Headlines and compressed style
korean-k10-l1.concept: News headlines and compressed noun phrases: 물가 안정 대책 발표.
korean-k10-l1.example: 물가 안정 대책을 발표했습니다. (mulga anjeong daechaegeul balpyohaesseumnida.) = announced price measures

korean-k10-l2.title: Current affairs and editorials
korean-k10-l2.concept: Reading short news articles: 친환경 에너지가 주목받고 있습니다.
korean-k10-l2.example: 친환경 에너지가 주목받고 있습니다. (chinhwan-gyeong eneojiga jumokbatgo isseumnida.) = clean energy popular

korean-k10-l3.title: Body-part idioms (발, 눈, 귀, 손)
korean-k10-l3.concept: Common idioms with body parts: 발이 넓다 (wide network), 눈이 높다 (high standards).
korean-k10-l3.example: 김 대리는 발이 넓어요. (gim daerineun bari neobeoyo.) = has wide connections / 눈이 높아요. (nuni nopayo.) = high standards choose

korean-k10-l4.title: Everyday action idioms (바가지, 어깨)
korean-k10-l4.concept: Expressions for common situations: 바가지를 쓰다 (ripped off), 어깨가 무겁다 (heavy duty).
korean-k10-l4.example: 바가지를 썼어요. (bagajireul sseosseoyo.) = ripped off price / 어깨가 무거워요. (eokkaega mugeowoyo.) = heavy responsibility burden

korean-k10-l5.title: Essential Korean proverbs
korean-k10-l5.concept: Wisdom in proverbs: 소 잃고 외양간 고친다, 쇠뿔도 단김에 빼라.
korean-k10-l5.example: 소 잃고 외양간 고친다. (so ilko oeyanggan gochinda.) = mend barn after losing cow / 쇠뿔도 단김에 빼라. (soeppuldo dangime ppaera.) = strike while iron hot

korean-k10-l6.title: Four-character idioms (사자성어)
korean-k10-l6.concept: Common four-character Chinese-derived idioms: 일석이조, 작심삼일, 다다익선.
korean-k10-l6.example: 일석이조예요. (ilseogijoyeyo.) = two birds one stone / 작심삼일이에요. (jaksimsamirieyo.) = three days resolve

korean-k10-l7.title: Logical connectors and discourse markers
korean-k10-l7.concept: Formal discourse markers: -에 따르면, 한편, 요컨대, 따라서.
korean-k10-l7.example: 의견에 따르면 그렇습니다. (uigyone ttareumyeon geureotsseumnida.) = according to opinion / 한편 다른 측면도 있습니다. (hanpyeon dareun cheungmyeondo isseumnida.) = on other hand another aspect

korean-k10-l8.title: Deep Korean cultural values and customs
korean-k10-l8.concept: Cultural concepts and holiday traditions: 따뜻한 정, 송편을 빚다.
korean-k10-l8.example: 따뜻한 정이 있어요. (ttatteutan jeongi isseoyo.) = warm jeong affection / 송편을 빚어요. (songpyeoneul bijeoyo.) = make songpyeon chuseok

korean-k10-l9.title: K10 Comprehensive Review
korean-k10-l9.concept: Mastery of Korean culture, media, idioms and formal debate expressions.
